content: Redis 8 is now available in Azure Managed Redis, bringing the latest Redis innovation to Azure's fully managed Redis service. With richer queries, atomic JSON updates, field-level expiration, and fine-grained security, Redis 8 simplifies development and helps you build sophisticated applications faster. With new vector capabilities, you can build AI-powered applications faster for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, recommendations, and agent memory. Azure Managed Redis helps you move beyond traditional caching and use Redis as a real-time data layer for modern and AI-driven applications. By combining Redis 8 with Azure's enterprise-grade reliability, security, and scalability, you can accelerate application performance, simplify AI architectures, and innovate with confidence on a fully managed service. Learn more.
